title: Sickly mosquito
summary: Weaken the sickly mosquito for the quest interaction and prepare for its final disease cast.
overview: Weaken the sickly mosquito for the quest interaction and prepare for its final disease cast.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: At 25% health a capture check begins every fifteen seconds.
The ranger must have dealt damage and hold the required capture tool in the primary slot; keep the mosquito alive while waiting for the capture check.
If the mosquito dies, it casts Epidermal Rot on a random hated target.
